request.description:
### User Login

**Endpoint:** `POST` /apps/login

**Authentication:** Basic Auth(requires middleware)  
**Description:** User Login into the System

### Change Password

**Endpoint:** `POST` /apps/reset-password

**Authentication:** Basic Auth(requires middleware)  
**Description:** User change password

### Get all Users

**Endpoint:** `POST` /apps/login

**Authentication:** Token  
**Description:** User Login into the System

item.description:
## Authentication

This API uses **Laravel Sanctum** for authentication.

### Token Usage

Include the token in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer {token}

 ```

### Token Generation

- Tokens are generated automatically during login/registration
    
- Tokens are personal access tokens tied to specific users
    
- Store tokens securely in your frontend (localStorage, sessionStorage, or secure cookies)
